temperature, different time: thickness decides how long the heat takes to reach the middle. Portion Air fryer Oven reheat Drumstick 375°F / 190°C · 6 min 375°F / 190°C · 15 min Thigh 375°F / 190°C · 8 min 375°F / 190°C · 20 min Breast or large piece 375°F / 190°C · 11 min 375°F / 190°C · 28 min Why the breading goes soggy in the fridge Fried chicken is a crisp, dry shell around wet meat. Overnight in a sealed box, moisture moves from the meat into the coating, and the cold air inside the box condenses on it too. By morning the crust is soft and slightly gummy. Put it straight into the air fryer and that water has to steam out before the coating can crisp, so the outside is still damp when the bone end is finally hot. The fix starts before reheating. Take the pieces out of the box and let them sit on a rack while the air fryer preheats, so the surface dries and the chill eases. Then a moderate heat finishes the job, crisping the crust and bringing the meat by the bone up to temperature at the same pace. Worked example: two thighs from the fridge Two leftover fried chicken thighs, rested uncovered on a rack while the air fryer heats. Preheat 4 minutes, put them in skin side up and heat at 375°F for 8 minutes, turning them at 4. A drumstick needs about 6 minutes and a large breast about 11. In a conventional oven, the same pieces reheat at 375°F for around 20 minutes on a rack over a tray. How to tell it is ready Check the thickest piece with a thermometer next to the bone, not touching it: USDA guidance is 165°F (74°C) for reheated leftovers. The coating should sound crisp when tapped and look dry, with a little fat sizzling around the pieces. A cold spot by the bone with a dark crust means the heat was too high for the size. Before it goes in Leave the pieces uncovered while you preheat, and blot any obvious grease from the bottom of the box off them. No extra oil is needed. Cook pieces of a similar size together, or add the smaller ones a few minutes later. Related presets Chicken thighs 380°F · 24 min · flip at 12 Leftover pizza 350°F · 4 min Leftover fries 375°F · 4 min · shake ×1 375°F oven to air fryer, every food → Oven to air fryer converter → All food presets → Printable conversion chart → Frequently asked questions How long do you reheat fried chicken in the air fryer? About 8 minutes at 375°F for a thigh, turned at 4. A drumstick takes around 6 minutes and a large breast around 11. What temperature should reheated chicken reach? 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part, which is USDA guidance for any reheated leftovers. Can I reheat KFC or other takeaway chicken this way? Yes. Pressure-fried takeaway chicken has a thicker coating, so give it the longer end of the time and check by the bone. Should I spray it with oil? No. The coating still holds plenty of oil from frying; extra oil only makes it greasy. How do I reheat fried chicken in the oven? On a rack over a tray at 375°F for around 20 minutes. The rack lets air reach the underside so it does not go soggy.
